purpose: Historical source migration inventory: PairIt returned to free listening with ads.
publication: Historical planning snapshot; payment removal is complete. See current README and release notes for published behavior.
target_behavior: Free app with existing AdMob ads subject to consent and normal eligibility
Four simultaneous listeners for everyone; no paid host requirement
Notification and lock-screen playback bypass in-app ad flow
No billing calls, purchase UI, license verification or payment SDK
